text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall from 96,822 to 109,776, but the path included declines; I should judge progress over a longer horizon, not month to month.","Doing nothing through these fluctuations has kept me invested without impulsive trades, so I should continue to trade only for a clear reason.","I should periodically review diversification, goals, and cash needs, while remembering that this record alone does not show which holdings drove the results."]}
